decisions.reason: Having its own product page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests the module cleared an initial market test, and for a German wholesale distributor the option value of keeping an established complementary product available likely still exceeds its carrying cost.

The add-on remained mentioned in 2024 and has at least one referenced installation, so management would likely keep this lower-cost option open despite weaker evidence and higher residual uncertainty than Product C.
